Dharam Prakash
--Petitioner
 Versus
Transport Commissioner and another
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel 
for petitioner.
2. Mr. Shyam Sunder Chaudhary, 
learned Standing Counsel for the State.
3. This Court vide order dated 
10.08.2026 directed the State Counsel to 
seek instructions as to whether the 
amount in dispute has been recovered
from the petitioner or not. 
4. Learned Standing Counsel for the 
State/respondent has passed on the 
instructions dated 20.08.2026 and 
submits that the amount has not yet been 
recovered. 
5. I have perused the instructions. The 
same is returned to the learned State 
Counsel.
6. The respondents may file the counter 
affidavit within a period of six weeks.
7. The petitioner has been working on a 
Class-3 post (driver) with the 
respondent/department; he has already  retired on 31.05.2024. The impugned 
order dated 18.07.2026 has been passed 
by respondent no.2 whereby it is directed 
that the recovery will be effected from the 
petitioner of the allegedly excess payment 
of salary made to him.
8. This Court is inclined to grant interim 
protection to the petitioner for the reason 
that no recovery can be made after 
retirement, and that too from a class-3 
employee on the ground of excess 
payment in which there is no involvement
of the petitioner.
9. Accordingly the impugned order
dated 18.07.2026 (Annexure No.-8 of the 
writ petition) is stayed till further orders.
10. List this case on 16.11.2026.
11. Stay Application IA NO. 01 of 2026 
stands disposed of. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 25.08.2026
Nahid
